nodes.v: A member of the team will call during office hours to agree a time that suits you, and to answer anything you want to ask before you come in.
We will check your insurance benefits in advance and send you anything you need to fill in, so your appointment is spent on your teeth rather than on paperwork.
Your exam, imaging and cleaning happen in one visit, and you leave with a written, itemised treatment plan. Nothing beyond that is started without your say-so.
If you do not hear from us within one business day, please call — we would rather answer twice than miss you. Note that we are closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

<style>*{box-sizing:border-box}*::before{box-sizing:border-box}*::after{box-sizing:border-box}</style><script data-embed="">
  MPD.add(function (M) {
    var pin = document.getElementById('nextPin');
    var spine = document.getElementById('nextSpine');
    var steps = gsap.utils.toArray('#nextSteps .next-step');
    var horizontal = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 760px)').matches;

    function litDot(dot, on) {
      gsap.to(dot, {
        borderColor: on ? '#00B4D8' : 'rgba(32, 36, 42, 0.12)',
        backgroundColor: on ? '#00B4D8' : '#F4F7F9',
        color: on ? '#ffffff' : '#5A6472',
        duration: 0.35, ease: 'none'
      });
    }

    if (M.reduced) {
      gsap.set(spine, horizontal ? { scaleX: 1 } : { scaleY: 1 });
      steps.forEach(function (s) { litDot(s.querySelector('.next-dot'), true); });
      return;
    }

    var tl = gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: pin,
        start: 'top top',
        end: '+=' + Math.round(window.innerHeight * 1.7),
        pin: true, scrub: 0.3, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true
      }
    });

    tl.fromTo(spine,
      horizontal ? { scaleX: 0 } : { scaleY: 0 },
      horizontal ? { scaleX: 1, ease: 'none', duration: 3 } : { scaleY: 1, ease: 'none', duration: 3 }, 0);

    steps.forEach(function (step, i) {
      tl.fromTo(step.querySelector('div'), { opacity: 0.15, y: 18 },
        { opacity: 1, y: 0, ease: 'none', duration: 0.7 }, i * 0.95);
    });

    /* Dots are painted from progress rather than tweened in place, so
       scrolling back up un-lights them and the chapter can be re-read. */
    tl.eventCallback('onUpdate', function () {
      var p = tl.progress() * 3;
      steps.forEach(function (step, i) {
        litDot(step.querySelector('.next-dot'), p >= i * 0.95 + 0.2);
      });
    });

    gsap.from('#next .chapter-tag, #next h2', {
      opacity: 0, y: 24, duration: 0.9, stagger: 0.1, ease: 'power3.out',
      scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#next', start: 'top 70%' }
    });
  });
  </script>
